audience: employers and HR teams that track clock punches and attendance in Truein

useCases.title: Find late arrivals on one day
useCases.text: Read the daily attendance log for a day to see who was present, absent or late. The staff list gives the names.

useCases.title: Summarise the hours worked
useCases.text: Get the timesheet summary per employee for a date range, with the leave split if needed.

useCases.title: Review leave waiting for approval
useCases.text: List the leave and short-leave requests with their approval status for a site or employee.

useCases.title: Check spoof alerts
useCases.text: List the punches that Truein flagged as possible spoofing, and the punch log of the employee.

useCases.title: Record a clock punch or leave request
useCases.text: Record a clock-in or clock-out punch, or submit a leave request for an employee. The request waits for approval.
